title: Report security-sensitive biological agent events within set times
what: A registered entity handling security-sensitive biological agents must report reportable events within the times the Regulations set.

sources.title: National Health Security Regulations 2018
sources.quote: 20 When reports must be given For the purposes of subsection 48(3) of the Act, a registered entity that must give a report about a reportable event mentioned in column 1 of an item of the following table must give the report within the period mentioned in column 2 of the item.
